attempt_interruption_events_shape_check.name: attempt_interruption_events_shape_check
attempt_interruption_events_shape_check.value:
(
          "attempt_interruption_events"."event_type" = 'detected'
          AND "attempt_interruption_events"."detection_source" IS NOT NULL
          AND "attempt_interruption_events"."time_adjustment_id" IS NULL
          AND (
            (
              "attempt_interruption_events"."detection_source" = 'heartbeat_timeout'
              AND "attempt_interruption_events"."observed_last_activity_at" IS NOT NULL
              AND "attempt_interruption_events"."timeout_seconds" IS NOT NULL
              AND "attempt_interruption_events"."timeout_seconds" > 0
            )
            OR
            (
              "attempt_interruption_events"."detection_source" = 'migration_backfill'
              AND "attempt_interruption_events"."timeout_seconds" IS NULL
              AND "attempt_interruption_events"."reason_code" = 'migration_backfill_unknown_detected_at'
            )
          )
        )
        OR
        (
          "attempt_interruption_events"."event_type" IN ('restored', 'terminalized')
          AND "attempt_interruption_events"."detection_source" IS NULL
          AND "attempt_interruption_events"."timeout_seconds" IS NULL
          AND "attempt_interruption_events"."observed_last_activity_at" IS NULL
        )

attempt_time_adjustments_source_shape_ch.name: attempt_time_adjustments_source_shape_check
attempt_time_adjustments_source_shape_ch.value:
(
          "attempt_time_adjustments"."source" = 'bounded_grace'
          AND "attempt_time_adjustments"."policy" = 'bounded_grace'
          AND "attempt_time_adjustments"."interruption_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "attempt_time_adjustments"."eligible_seconds" IS NOT NULL
          AND "attempt_time_adjustments"."actor_id" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "attempt_time_adjustments"."source" IN ('operator', 'administrative_correction')
          AND "attempt_time_adjustments"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "attempt_time_adjustments"."reason_text" IS NOT NULL
          AND length(btrim("attempt_time_adjustments"."reason_text")) > 0
        )
        OR "attempt_time_adjustments"."source" = 'system_incident'

email_outbox_processing_must_have_lock.name: email_outbox_processing_must_have_lock
email_outbox_processing_must_have_lock.value: ("email_outbox"."status" <> 'processing') OR ("email_outbox"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "email_outbox"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL)

email_outbox_non_processing_no_lock.name: email_outbox_non_processing_no_lock
email_outbox_non_processing_no_lock.value: ("email_outbox"."status" = 'processing') OR ("email_outbox"."locked_at" IS NULL AND "email_outbox"."locked_by" IS NULL)

exam_attempts_interruption_snapshot_caps.name: exam_attempts_interruption_snapshot_caps_check
exam_attempts_interruption_snapshot_caps.value:
(
          "exam_attempts"."interruption_time_policy_snapshot" IN ('strict', 'operator_incident')
          AND "exam_attempts"."interruption_grace_per_incident_seconds_snapshot" IS NULL
          AND "exam_attempts"."interruption_grace_per_attempt_seconds_snapshot" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "exam_attempts"."interruption_time_policy_snapshot" = 'bounded_grace'
          AND "exam_attempts"."interruption_grace_per_incident_seconds_snapshot" IS NOT NULL
          AND "exam_attempts"."interruption_grace_per_attempt_seconds_snapshot" IS NOT NULL
          AND "exam_attempts"."interruption_grace_per_incident_seconds_snapshot" > 0
          AND "exam_attempts"."interruption_grace_per_attempt_seconds_snapshot" > 0
          AND "exam_attempts"."interruption_grace_per_incident_seconds_snapshot" <= "exam_attempts"."interruption_grace_per_attempt_seconds_snapshot"
        )

exam_attempts_current_interruption_pair_.name: exam_attempts_current_interruption_pair_check
exam_attempts_current_interruption_pair_.value:
("exam_attempts"."current_interruption_id" IS NULL AND "exam_attempts"."interrupted_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("exam_attempts"."current_interruption_id" IS NOT NULL AND "exam_attempts"."interrupted_at" IS NOT NULL)

exams_interruption_policy_caps_check.name: exams_interruption_policy_caps_check
exams_interruption_policy_caps_check.value:
(
          "exams"."interruption_time_policy" IN ('strict', 'operator_incident')
          AND "exams"."interruption_grace_per_incident_seconds" IS NULL
          AND "exams"."interruption_grace_per_attempt_seconds" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "exams"."interruption_time_policy" = 'bounded_grace'
          AND "exams"."interruption_grace_per_incident_seconds" IS NOT NULL
          AND "exams"."interruption_grace_per_attempt_seconds" IS NOT NULL
          AND "exams"."interruption_grace_per_incident_seconds" > 0
          AND "exams"."interruption_grace_per_attempt_seconds" > 0
          AND "exams"."interruption_grace_per_incident_seconds" <= "exams"."interruption_grace_per_attempt_seconds"
        )
